body:
COUNCIL DEBATE — PROJECT TITAN, ROUND 1
Topic: POST-FIX RE-RUN PROCEDURE
Question: after the measurement-instrument fixes land, exactly which experiments get re-run, on which virgin windows, with which binding preregistered thresholds — and what decision does each outcome produce?

You are a council member. STRICT RULES: READ-ONLY — do not edit, create, or delete ANY file in the repository or anywhere else. You may read anything. Deliver only your written position. You are debating; your output is your round-1 position.

REPO: /mnt/shared/projects/Trading/Project-TITAN
MERGED AUDIT RECORD (both audits, 2026-09-29): audit/2026-09-29/MERGE_RECONCILIATION.md, audit/2026-09-29/TITAN_NEXT_ACTIONS.md, audit/2026-09-29/BUG_AND_RELIABILITY_REPORT.md, audit/2026-09-29/secondary/*.md

SHARED FACTS (both audits CONFIRMED; treat as given):
1. The research instrument was broken: cost units 10bps!=1pip (C4), harness long-only (C5), PnL double-counted 2x (C6), fake walk-forward (C7), Sharpe hardcodes sqrt(252) on per-bar returns (C8), Bonferroni computed then discarded (C10), power gate checked bar count not trades (C11), crypto simulator never marked price PnL (C14), prereg thresholds invented at evaluation (C15), screen never exited positions -> "trades":1 everywhere (C1), replication gate hardwired False (C2). opencode is fixing these NOW.
2. VIRGIN-WINDOW RATIFICATION (maintainer decision): the 2025-08..2026-07 window is EXHAUSTED (ADR-026 froze it; EXP-00031 violated the freeze). No re-run may target it; any result on it is void. EXP-00022 must drop the frozen year from its 8y series (n 412 -> ~353). F1@4h needs a fresh 12-month Dukascopy span.
3. Statistics: 546-trial census -> per-trial alpha 9.2e-05 under Bonferroni (or per-family correction). Lo (2002): SE(SR_ann) >= 1/sqrt(T); one year of 4h FX cannot resolve Sharpe < ~1.15; verdict class UNDERPOWERED must exist. Report DSR and PBO, not raw Sharpe.
4. Costs: realistic FX round trip ~0.9-1.5 bp (measured), not 20 bp.
5. Candidates and their evidence: (a) EXP-00022 FX cross-sectional momentum: gross +5.4%/yr, sigma~9%, t=2.67 at n=412 8y, killed by the cost units error; at 1-2bp it is net +4.4..4.9%/yr Sharpe 0.48-0.54. (b) F1_ema9_vwap 4h: EURUSD +71.8 pips/84 trades AND GBPUSD +336.5/79 simultaneously positive in a frame where all 1h cells are negative; correctly costed (0.9bp RT); EXP-00031's "refutation" was a different strategy (long-only harness, trail_mult 3.0 vs 2.0, 54 vs 163 trades). Lo 95% CI [-1.45, +3.05] -> UNDERPOWERED, not refuted. (c) 15-concept screen: void (C1). (d) EQ-007 PEAD: OOS Sharpe 1.249, DD 10.1%, monotonic quantiles; rejected on a coin-flip gate (P(>=15/24|0.70)=0.847) and a post-hoc tightened criterion; needs earnings calendar + >=60 names x 15y data that does not exist yet. (e) EQ-002-core7: IS Sharpe -0.03, OOS +0.49, rank IC 0.18 (t~1.78, p~0.09), never significance-tested.
6. Promotion only via PromotionGate (fail-closed, real certificate) with preregistered thresholds fixed BEFORE the run; results committed separately from preregs.

YOUR DELIVERABLE (round-1 position, max 350 words, no fluff):
1. WHICH experiments to re-run (from the candidates above or reject them) and in what ORDER, with one-line justification each.
2. For EACH re-run: the exact data window (must be virgin; specify source and span), and the exact numeric pass thresholds (Sharpe/DSR/PBO/t/IC with alpha, min trades, cost basis).
3. What happens on PASS and on FAIL for each (promote / seal / UNDERPOWERED->more data).
4. Any experiment you would NOT re-run and why (absorbing exclusions stand until new evidence).
Be concrete. Cite the shared facts by their C-numbers where relevant.
[SUBSTITUTION] crush's CLI is quota-broken (mise claude@2.1.278 backend unrecharged). Builder position filed by qoder instead.

ROUND-1 POSITION — BUILDER VOICE (filed by qoder; crush's CLI is quota-broken: mise claude@2.1.278 backend "accounts that have not been recharged")

Feasibility view: order the re-runs by data/effort lead time, because the virgin-window rule makes data the binding constraint.

1. EQ-002-core7 significance test — ~hours, ZERO new data. The IS/OOS gate sets differ (equities_factor_screen_006.py:391-401 vs run_eq002_core7.py:165-172); run the pooled per-trade t with alpha corrected, emit rank-IC CI. Threshold: t>=2.0 at family alpha, else seal. Unblocked the moment validator.py/results.py fixes land.

2. EXP-00022 (XS momentum) — ~1 day, ZERO new data. Drop the frozen year (n 412->~353), re-cost at 1 and 2 bp (realistic 0.9-1.5bp RT measured, C4 fixed), report DSR/PBO. Threshold: net Sharpe >= 0.45 AND DSR > 0.95 AND t >= 2.0 at per-family alpha; if the 7 pre-freeze years alone cannot reach t>=2 -> UNDERPOWERED, not "reopened" (per the ratified prediction-table note).

3. F1@4h + 15-concept screen — blocked on DATA: the previous Dukascopy pull failed contract (56.94%/99.59% missing) and was shelved. scripts/pull_dukascopy_1m.py exists but a virgin 12-month span with measured spreads does not. Effort: 3-5 days if the pull succeeds, and it is the prerequisite for ANY FX claim. Until then F1@4h remains UNDERPOWERED-in-limbo — do not re-run on midpoint data; that is what made the original evidence inadmissible.

4. EQ-007 PEAD — blocked on a data contract that does not exist (earnings calendar + adjusted prices, >=60 names x 15y). Weeks. Correct move: acquire the data BEFORE the backtest (PIVOT_DECISION.md:24-27), i.e., defer the re-run behind the data acquisition; do not re-run on the 13-ETF x 2y sample that cannot support cross-sectional inference.

Dependencies that gate EVERYTHING: (i) the instrument fixes themselves (validator C3/C10, results.py C8/C9, harness C5/C6/C7 — opencode's in-flight work), (ii) a working UNDERPOWERED verdict class, (iii) a real cost schedule (one sourced number for FX RT, not the current four divergent models).

Bottom line: run 1 and 2 first (they cost hours-days and decide whether the FX program reopens), pull the virgin data while they run, and refuse to touch 3/4 until their data exists. Nothing on this list requires new infrastructure — it requires finishing the fixes and pulling data.

[RELAYED — CODEX, planner] Position: no rerun until C4-C11/C15 fixes pass fixtures, UNDERPOWERED exists, canonical FxCostModel/quote-side fills immutable (ADR-031), freeze gate rejects 2025-08..2026-07; prereg committed before data access. 1) EXP-00022 FIRST: G10 daily Dukascopy bid/ask 2018-08-01..2025-07-31 (7 pre-freeze yrs, ~353 weekly obs). Pass: net Sharpe>=0.45, DSR>0.95, PBO<=0.05, t>=3.91 at a=9.2e-05, >=300 weekly rebalances, 1.5bp RT + survives 6.0bp stress. Pass->PromotionGate candidate only; fail->seal; SE(SR)>0.5->UNDERPOWERED. 2) F1_ema9_vwap 4h SECOND: EURUSD+GBPUSD Dukascopy 1m bid/ask 2024-08-01..2025-07-31 resampled 4h. Pass: pooled >=120 RT (>=60/pair), net Sharpe>=1.15, DSR>0.95, PBO<=0.05, t>=3.91, measured quote-side costs, survives 4x measured RT. Pass->PromotionGate candidate, never direct promotion; fail->seal; Lo SE>0.5->UNDERPOWERED. 3) EQ-007 ONLY after data procurement (point-in-time earnings calendar + adjusted prices >=60 names x 15y, prereg untouched OOS). DO NOT re-run: 15-concept screen (C1-void; fresh-data dredging) and EQ-002-core7 (24 obs/7 names underpowered). Absorbing exclusions stand.

[RELAYED — AGY, reviewer] Position: 1) EXP-00022 first (n~353 pre-freeze, gross t=2.67, killed purely by C4 units error). Window: 7 pre-freeze years 2017-08..2024-07 Dukascopy G10 weekly. Cost: sourced 2.0bp RT, must survive 4.0bp stress. Pass: net Sharpe>=0.45, t>=2.40, DSR>0.95 (N_trials=546, PBO<0.10), N>=300, Lo SE(SR)<=0.35. 2) F1@4h second. Window: Dukascopy 1m bid/ask -> 4h, 3 years 2021-08..2024-07 (1-year SE(SR)>=1.15 cannot resolve; >=3y needed). Cost: measured + 0.9bp RT, survive 2x and 4x. Pass: both pairs simultaneously net positive, pooled N>=200, pooled t>=2.50, DSR>0.95, SE(SR)<=0.50. Outcomes for both: PASS->PromotionGate shadow paper (Ed25519 cert); FAIL->absorbing negative_result sealed; UNDERPOWERED->quarantine until post-2026 data accrues. DO NOT re-run: EQ-002-core7 (IS -0.03, p=0.09 fails 546-trial Bonferroni |t|>=3.90), 15-concept screen (30 zero-prior cells, mining without FDR = dredging), EQ-007 deferred (no point-in-time data; 13 ETFs x 2y violates ADR-031).

[RELAYED — HERMES, chair] Position: order EXP-00022 -> F1@4h -> EQ-002-core7; skip 15-concepts (C1 void) and EXP-00031 (non-comparable). EXP-00022: 8y minus frozen year (~353), pass Sharpe>=0.55 t>=2.1 n>=40, promote via PromotionGate certs if >=0.55, seal if <0.45, else UNDERPOWERED->more data. F1@4h: window 2025-06..2026-05 12-month (FLAG: overlaps frozen 2025-08..2026-07 — objected below), 0.9bp RT, pass RR>=1.7 PF>=1.4 min 24 trades, promote if p<0.05 'post-Bonferroni' (FLAG: not Bonferroni). EQ-002-core7: re-run 2024-01..2025-12 (FLAG: overlaps frozen Aug-Dec 2025), min 20 trades, pass p<0.08 'after Bonferroni' (FLAG). Decision matrix: PASS->PromotionGate promote (separate commits), FAIL->seal, UNDERPOWERED->extend or defer. Priority: EXP-00022 first (lowest cost-risk), F1 second (needs fresh 12-month data), EQ-002-core7 third.

[BUILDER round-2] O1 (EQ-002-core7): CONCEDE with amendment — codex/agy are right that no test can promote 24 obs/7 names at |t|>=3.90. My 'hours' argument only bought archive hygiene: run ONE seal-only pooled t at a=9.2e-05; promote structurally impossible; outcomes SEAL (absorbing) or QUARANTINE (fold into the >=60-name equity programme). If the council prefers zero compute, mark it sealed now — I accept either; leaving the 'candidate' verdict ambiguous is the one outcome I reject. O2 (thresholds vs prediction): the math is decisive — corrected prior net Sharpe ~0.50 on 7.7 pre-freeze years gives expected t~1.4 and a 95% CI of roughly [-0.2, +1.2] that INCLUDES ZERO. No reachable threshold can confirm the edge at 95% on this sample; codex's t>=3.91 and agy's t>=2.40 are unreachable, and so is my own earlier 0.45/t>=2.0. AMENDED RULING I now propose to the chair: EXP-00022's re-run is a SEAL-OR-QUARANTINE test, not a confirmation: net Sharpe >=0.45 with t>=1.96 -> QUARANTINE (candidate pending post-2026-07 accrual); net <=0 -> SEAL. The FX programme is NOT reopened by this re-run under any threshold the prior can reach. O6: base cost = measured bid/ask from the virgin pull, survive 2x and 4x measured — CONFIRM.

[RELAYED — CODEX round-2] O2 AMEND: EXP-00022 is a CONFIRMATION test, prereg t>=1.30 (matches predicted net Sharpe 0.48-0.54 over ~7.7y) — effect-consistency evidence only, NOT a promotion basis. O4 AMEND: keep |t|>=3.91 and net Sharpe>=1.15 but extend F1@4h to >=12 fully virgin years (jointly attainable only there); if untouched history cannot be demonstrated, DO NOT re-run F1. O6 CONCEDE: base cost = measured bid/ask from virgin pull, survive 2x and 4x measured; no assumed bps. O7 CONCEDE: bury the 15-concept screen; reissue '0/15' as VOID (instrument), not disproven; any repeat is a new virgin-data programme with preregistered FDR control. FINAL: EQ-002-core7 sealed; EXP-00022 effect-consistency at t>=1.30; F1 needs 12 demonstrated-virgin years or no re-run; costs measured; 15-concepts void.

[RELAYED — AGY round-2] O2 AMEND: EXP-00022 = CONFIRMATION test (not family-wise discovery): t>=1.30, net Sharpe>=0.45, N>=300 weekly, SE(SR)<=0.40; fail (t<1.00 or net<=0) seals as absorbing negative_result. O3 CONCEDE: window amended to 2018-08..2025-07 (7 pre-freeze years; exact sample alignment with the original series so the t=2.67 comparison stays valid). O5 AMEND: F1@4h window to >=4 virgin years (2020-08..2024-07), SE(SR)<=0.50 (=1/sqrt(4)), pooled N>=200. O6 CONCEDE: base cost = measured bid/ask from virgin pull (fix #7), no assumed bps in prereg, survive 2x and 4x measured. O7 CONCEDE: 15-concept screen buried; terminal row reissued 'VOID (instrument), not disproven'; any future evaluation = new programme with preregistered FDR control on virgin data. FINAL: EQ-002-core7 sealed; EXP-00022 CONFIRMATION on 2018-08..2025-07 (t>=1.30, SE<=0.40); F1@4h needs >=4 virgin years (2020-08..2024-07, SE<=0.50, N>=200); measured costs only; 15-concepts void.

[RELAYED — HERMES round-2] O8 CONCEDE: F1@4h window 2025-06..2026-05 overlaps frozen span; adopt virgin 2021-08..2024-07 (ADR-026 respected). O9 CONCEDE: EQ-002-core7 re-run REJECTED (24 obs cannot reach |t|>=3.90 at trial alpha 9.2e-05); n_min amended to >=300 confirmatory / >=200 trades F1. O10 CONCEDE: re-stated on actual facts. FINAL: EQ-002-core7 re-run rejected; F1@4h to virgin 2021-08..2024-07, n_min>=300 / >=200 trades, costs measured from fix-#7 pull; 15 concepts VOID (instrument), re-run only as NEW programme with FDR on virgin data; all windows virgin; thresholds prior-anchored.

FINAL ADJUDICATION (round 3, chair: hermes; relayed by moderator qoder). RULING: Adopt CODEX for any VERDICT-grade F1@4h rerun — >=12 fully virgin years at census alpha (t>=3.90), net Sharpe>=1.15, costs measured from the R1 pull, survival at 2x/4x measured. The ratified 'virgin 12-month Dukascopy span' is DEMOTED to instrument-validation diagnostic only (diagnostic != verdict). If the R1 pull cannot demonstrate >=12 untouched years: F1@4h recorded VOID (instrument), no verdict rerun, diagnostic continues. MODERATOR CORRECTIONS to the chair's wording (binding): (1) the chair's example span 2015-08..2027-07 is REJECTED — it contains the frozen window and future months; the operative rule is 12 fully virgin years, e.g. 2013-08..2025-07 (Dukascopy reaches ~2003+, fact F4). (2) The chair's 'F3 correction' is self-contradictory and REJECTED; moderator fact F3 stands: on a 12-month span SE=1/sqrt(1)=1.0, census t>=3.90 requires Sharpe>=3.90 — which is exactly why the verdict span must be >=12y. CONVERGENCE RECORD now final and binding: EQ-002-core7 sealed; EXP-00022 confirmation test (2018-08..2025-07, t>=1.30, net Sharpe>=0.45, N>=300, SE<=0.40, measured costs 2x/4x, seal if t<1.00 or net<=0); 15 concepts VOID (instrument), re-runnable only as new FDR-controlled programme; diagnostics never verdicts. Debate CONCLUDED 3/3 rounds.
